techniques.name: Mission & Architectural Philosophy
techniques.description: Create a high-end auteur cinematography showcase inspired by 35mm archival film and Swiss editorial typography. Enforce architectural restraint: avoid cheap neon glows, oversaturated gradients, and childish AI aesthetic defaults.

techniques.name: Masked Video Clip-Path Reveals
techniques.description: Implement scroll-synchronized polygonal clip-path reveals that expand film stills from a 4:5 vertical editorial portrait into an expansive 16:9 cinematic landscape as the user scrolls into view. Use hardware-accelerated CSS clip-path polygon transitions driven by requestAnimationFrame without causing layout recalculations or layout shifts..

techniques.name: Kinetic Roman Numeral Chapter Navigation
techniques.description: Choreograph roman numeral scene markers (e.g., I, II, III, IV) with letter-by-letter kinetic stagger reveals. As each project scrolls into the viewport, animate line-height and opacity using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) easing.

techniques.name: Magnetic Project Index Pill
techniques.description: Engineer an ergonomic floating index pill that subtly shifts position when the cursor enters within a 120px threshold radius. Apply dampened spring physics with a spring constant of 0.28 and mass damping of 0.85, gently returning to origin on mouse exit.

techniques.name: Inertia Horizontal Film Pan
techniques.description: Build a horizontal timeline strip showcasing film project frames using CSS subgrid and translate3d transforms. Synchronize progress with native scroll timelines without using wheel event preventDefault or fake smooth-scrolling hijackers, ensuring trackpads, mouse wheels, and mobile touch gestures remain completely natural.

techniques.name: Dual-Stack Runtime Detection & Serving Protocol
techniques.description: When inspecting scaffolded or delivered project packages, analyze whether the archive is a framework project (containing package.json) or a clean static web package (HTML, CSS, JS assets). Never invent or force an unnecessary React/Next.js framework scaffolding if the delivered project is already a complete, fast static site; conversely, never flatten an existing React/Next.js component structure into static HTML.

techniques.name: Targeted Incremental Baseline Refactoring
techniques.description: When applying follow-up creative changes (copywriting, typography scales, colorways, sections, or interactive features), preserve the delivered architectural structure, styling system, and motion tokens as the baseline. Prefer small, targeted, non-destructive delta edits over regenerating the entire site.

techniques.name: Dragonfly Biomimetic Optics & Agile Kinematics
techniques.description: Inspired by the compound optics and structural iridescence of the dragonfly. Replaces static glass with angle-dependent thin-film interference sheens, skeletal wireframe structures, and ultra-agile, zero-latency micro-interactions that mimic biomimetic aerial hovering.

techniques.name: Alethia Stratigraphic Materiality & Geospatial Truth
techniques.description: Derived from the Greek 'Alētheia' (unconcealed truth) and terrestrial geology. Eliminates artificial surface gloss in favor of honest mineral textures (obsidian, basalt, raw terra-cotta), stratigraphic elevation cross-sections, and topographic scroll contouring.

techniques.name: Alethia Geospatial Telemetry & Orthographic Earth Projections
techniques.description: Scientific geospatial HUD and restrained 3D orthographic Earth projection. Features Great-Circle trigonometric wireframe coordinates, elevation counters, solar terminator lighting, and latitude/longitude spatial markers without noisy neon clutter.

techniques.name: O-SCS Spatial Control Surface & Precision HUD Docking
techniques.description: Ergonomic spatial control surface featuring magnetic panel docking, 3D viewport orientation gizmo, matrix3d spatial camera transformations, and mission-critical telemetry reticles without noisy blur or neon bloom.

techniques.name: Izanami Shadow-Craft, Sumi Ink Dispersion & Ma Spacing
techniques.description: Japanese aesthetic architecture inspired by 'In Praise of Shadows' (In-ei Raisan). Features deep Urushi lacquer black, Kinpaku gold foil leafing, meditative Ma negative space, and organic Sumi-e fluid ink displacement filters.

techniques.name: Tile Tactile Tessellation, Grout Hairlines & Modular Slate
techniques.description: Architectural grid framework derived from ceramic tile tessellation, honed slate materiality, and precision grout hairlines. Features interlocking proportional modules (1:1, 1:2, 2:1, 2:2), 1px structural container gap lines, micro-beveled inner shadow relief, and haptic physical depression kinematics.

techniques.name: Romanelli Kinetic Viewport, Inertial Velocity Warp & Monochromatic Editorial Noir
techniques.description: Auteur portfolio architecture inspired by Italian creative developer Mirko Romanelli. Features an ephemeral cursor-anchored preview portal, velocity-driven skew transforms, seamless full-screen canvas transitions, and stark monochromatic typography with extreme scale contrast.

techniques.name: 247 Artists Sonic Telemetry, Global Studio Time & Roster Waveforms
techniques.description: Analog recording studio telemetry architecture derived from international artist rosters and 24/7 music collectives. Features precision decibel VU meters, zero-latency inline audio waveform scrubbers, live multi-timezone studio status badges, and tactile brushed aluminum materiality.

techniques.name: Cylindrical Curved Carousel Projection & Dynamic Rounded Quad Geometry
techniques.description: Mathematical inside-of-a-cylinder carousel projection that dynamically curves, scales, and offsets cards based on normalized radial distance to center. Uses non-linear edge height scaling, rounded trapezoidal clip-path quads, frame-relative units, and 1:1 pointer drag with momentum coasting.

techniques.name: Video Atlas Single-Stream Grid Sync & Viewport Tile Offsetting
techniques.description: High-performance video architecture that packs multiple synchronized video clips into a single 5x2 composite video texture (atlas). Eliminates multi-video network thrashing and mobile GPU decoder limits by downloading one shared media stream and offsetting viewports geometrically.

techniques.name: Sticky Stacking Card Deck with Scale Decay & Viewport Pinning
techniques.description: Transforms a sequence of project cards into an overlapping physical card deck. Each card pins to a sticky viewport threshold while subsequent cards stack over it, applying a subtle scale reduction (targetScale = 1 - (total - 1 - i) * 0.03) to create physical depth without 3D meshes.

techniques.name: Scroll-Driven Character Opacity Wave & Fluid Editorial Stagger
techniques.description: Directs editorial reading focus by progressively illuminating text character-by-character as the user scrolls. Characters transition from ambient opacity 0.2 to full opacity 1.0 based on viewport progress, eliminating layout shift with ghost spans.

techniques.name: Farminerals Geochemical Soil Chromatography & Agronomic Terroir Materiality
techniques.description: Agronomic visual architecture derived from geochemical soil remineralization and volcanic geology. Employs the scientific Munsell Soil Color system (humus loam, terracotta silt, basalt, calcified chalk), pulverized mineral micro-texture, and laboratory Certificate of Analysis (CoA) batch telemetry.

techniques.name: Ricardo Isometric Spatial Console, Rotary Potentiometers & Multi-Plane Z-Elevation
techniques.description: Tactile industrial hardware console architecture utilizing pure isometric CSS 3D projections (rotateX 60deg, rotateZ -45deg), multi-plane Z-axis elevation on hover, authentic rotary potentiometer dials with knurled metal textures, and physical detent physics.

techniques.name: Typo Love Kinetic Variable Font Axes, Glyph Morphing & Specimen Architecture
techniques.description: Architectural typographic system celebrating letterforms as dynamic structures. Employs multi-axis variable font interpolations (weight, width, slant), cursor proximity weight waves, OpenType discretionary ligatures, typographic proof bounding boxes, and strict 8px baseline rhythm.

techniques.name: Meech Street-Luxe Neo-Brutalism, Draggable Holographic Artifacts & Industrial Stencils
techniques.description: Raw street-luxe visual architecture fusing underground culture with high-fashion editorial discipline. Features physics-based draggable holographic stickers, raw asphalt and concrete textures, industrial gaffer tape clip-path masks, and flash-photography contrast.

techniques.name: Damped Magnetic Cursor Follow Physics with Asymmetric Ease Timing
techniques.description: Ergonomic magnetic interaction that pulls hero elements toward cursor coordinates within a proximity threshold radius (150px) using strength attenuation and asymmetric easing (snappy 0.3s engagement vs viscous 0.6s release).

techniques.name: Dual-Row Opposing Scroll-Coupled Marquee Kinematics
techniques.description: Translates vertical scroll position directly into synchronized opposing horizontal motion. Row 1 translates rightward while Row 2 translates leftward using dynamic scroll offsets, passive scroll listeners, and array triplication for seamless infinite looping.

techniques.name: Queue-Gated Mouse-Scrub Video Kinematics & Hardware Anti-Flood Seeking
techniques.description: Interactive video timeline architecture that smoothly scrubs video playback via horizontal mouse velocity. Solves video decoder freeze and frame-drop through an asynchronous onSeeked queue latch that buffers target time mutations without flooding the hardware decoder.

techniques.name: Conversational Action Pill Triage & Optical Depth-of-Field Layering
techniques.description: Hero section interaction architecture combining intentional optical blur (filter: blur(4px)) on ambient intro text, cadence-gated typewriter storytelling with stepped cursor, and a responsive triage cluster of action pill buttons with one-click clipboard copy.

techniques.name: Scroll-Driven 3D GLTF Flight Path & Inertial Banking Kinematics
techniques.description: Binds a photorealistic 3D model to document scroll progress using normalized viewport keyframes, hold-and-dive transition kinematics, and velocity-coupled Euler banking (pitch coupled to vertical speed, roll coupled to lateral speed).

techniques.name: Procedural Multi-Layer Alpha-Threshold Wing Flutter & Ghosted Motion Blur
techniques.description: Synthesizes ultra-realistic biological wing kinematics on wingless GLTF models: processes photographic black-background wing textures into dynamic luminance alpha channels, attaches triple-phase offset ghost meshes for zero-cost motion blur, and accelerates flap frequency with flight velocity.

techniques.name: Scroll-Synchronized Multidirectional Flora Parallax & Active Viewport Theme Triage
techniques.description: Orchestrates multidirectional botanical diorama layers with individual speed multipliers and continuous stem rotation without layout thrashing. Features active viewport intersection probing to smoothly toggle dark/light theme classes on fixed navigation chrome.
